steps.title: Tell us about your chapter
steps.text: Send the chapter site and the events on your MarCom calendar.

steps.title: Pick the month's interview
steps.text: We go over the calendar with you and choose the member or chapter leader to interview.

steps.title: We interview and write
steps.text: We turn the interview into articles, and we line up member content to republish and the month's video.

steps.title: You approve, the chapter posts
steps.text: You sign off on each piece, and the articles, posts, and video go out on your schedule.

items.question: How much time does this take from a MarCom chair?
items.answer: A planning call each month, the monthly video, and time to review drafts. We handle the interview, the writing, the editing, and the posting.

items.question: What does the chapter package cost?
items.answer: $500 a month for four articles from one monthly interview, republished member content, social posts on LinkedIn and your other channels, and one video each month supplied by the chapter, with light editing.

items.question: Who approves what goes out?
items.answer: You do. Nothing reaches the chapter's site or social channels until the MarCom chair or the chapter board signs off.

items.question: Why not have ChatGPT write the chapter's content?
items.answer: ChatGPT is no longer the answer. Humans will deliver a much more reliable stream of content than ChatGPT.

items.question: Can you help our chapter start a podcast?
items.answer: Yes. I attended the MarCom sessions at the EO Global Leadership Conference in Honolulu, and the number one recommendation was video and audio. We can help you do that.

items.question: Can you create content from our event photos?
items.answer: Yes. We can take your chapter's photos and create content around them.

items.question: Can you interview our members directly?
items.answer: Yes, we interview the member or chapter leader you pick each month, and you get four articles from that interview for your blog or LinkedIn.

items.question: Who writes the content?
items.answer: Human writers on the Content Cucumber team, assigned to your chapter so they learn its members, its events, and its voice.

items.question: Can I sign up my own company as an EO member?
items.answer: Yes. EO members get 50% off the first three months to try it, and we can have a special price for them going forward.

items.question: What is the free AI search audit?
items.answer: A review of how Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other AI answer engines find and describe your chapter or your company, and where others get cited instead. We walk through the findings on a call.

data.title: Let's Talk About Your Chapter
data.text: Send us your chapter site and your MarCom calendar. We set up a call, run the free AI search audit, and show you how we can help.
